strategies.title: GOV FILINGS PIPELINE FINDINGS
strategies.about: Stocks the SEC and DoD filing pipeline found: contract awards, sale reviews, spin-offs and lock-ups, each with a verdict.

strategies.title: STRAT: OVERHANG
strategies.about: Registered share supply (resale S-1s, lock-up expiries) waiting to hit the market. The test: buy only after the supply has been absorbed.

strategies.title: STRAT: SPIN-OFF
strategies.about: Spin-offs and their parents: forced index and holder selling in the first weeks, then the re-rating test.
